_readme: S730 subject-title hunt (Sam, 2026-11-25: the printed local subject titles decide each local code's common subject and unblock the 88 stray M-ID codes, r-no-mid-on-a-stray-code-sam-2026-11-25). Pass 2 of this plan (pass 1 read run 45623555503): College of the Canyons prints no prefix legend (pass 1). Its Program/Course Descriptions section (pages 62 to 312, noncredit from 313) heads each department with the department's name, repeated as a running header under the line CREDIT PROGRAMS / COURSE DESCRIPTIONS. This headings read prints, once each, every all-caps line and the first course of every code, with the one line above it, so a session reads which header sits over each code's first course. No model call.
